name: PrimeTTS v2.1 Nano latency: 4 concurrent real-time requests, quality preserved

description: Baseline: 4 concurrent T81 requests on the Nano (resident GPU weights + per-stream arenas/streams), SNDR 70.08 dB

asi.hypothesis: establish the session baseline before any change
asi.noise_floor_note: N=4 wall measured 9917 ms and 10308 ms on two identical runs: ~4% run-to-run spread on the Nano; treat sub-4% deltas as noise
asi.phase_split: single stream T81: GPU kernels+sync 1673 ms, staging copies 39 ms, alloc/free 0; total run 4.44 s, so ~2.7 s is host graph work serialized against the GPU
asi.next_action_hint: attack the host side first (elementwise ops are scalar C; 4066 nodes; ~2.7 s of a 4.44 s stream)
asi.memory: free RAM dips to ~1119 MB with 4 streams at 32 MB arenas; guard is 60 MB so there is headroom
